mapper.sql: id, review_task_id, conversation_id, content_revision, format, status, preview_plan_json, cover_object_key, cover_file_size, video_object_key, video_file_size, duration_ms, error_message, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_content_preview_task(review_task_id, conversation_id, content_revision, format, status, preview_plan_json, created_by) values(#{reviewTaskId}, #{conversationId}, #{contentRevision}, #{format}, #{status}, #{previewPlanJson}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select from ai_content_preview_task where status='PENDING' order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_content_preview_task set status='PROCESSING', started_at=coalesce(started_at, now()), finished_at=null, error_message=null where id=#{id} and status='PENDING'

update ai_content_preview_task set status='SUCCESS', format=#{format}, cover_object_key=#{coverObjectKey}, cover_file_size=#{coverFileSize}, video_object_key=#{videoObjectKey}, video_file_size=#{videoFileSize}, duration_ms=#{durationMs}, error_message=null, finished_at=now() where id=#{id} and status='PROCESSING'
update ai_content_preview_task set status='FAILED', error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=now() where id=#{id} and status='PROCESSING'

update ai_content_preview_task set status='PENDING', cover_object_key=null, cover_file_size=null, video_object_key=null, video_file_size=null, duration_ms=null, error_message=null, started_at=null, finished_at=null where id=#{id} and status in ('FAILED','SUCCESS')
update ai_content_preview_task set status='FAILED', error_message='成品渲染中断，请手动重试', finished_at=now() where status='PROCESSING' and updated_at < #{updatedBefore}
